scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Dependent Children Of Widows And Destitute Women
other_conditions: Applicant must be a widow or destitute woman, or the legal guardian of the child/children
Applicant must have resided in the Union Territory of Chandigarh for more than 3 years
Child must be 18 years of age or younger
Child must not be receiving any family pension from any State or Central Government
Children who are under institutional care by government or NGOs are not eligible
Assistance is limited to up to two children per family
benefits_summary: ₹1000 per month per child, for up to two children, to meet maintenance and education costs.
